source_documents.purpose: Defines the 3 core periods plus Google competency and interview question alignment.
Defines WOMmedia ecosystem brands and the Google Web Tools / Firebase alignment narrative.

portfolio.target_role: B2B Lead Generation & Cross-Platform Ad Arbitrage (Meta/Google Ads Ecosystem)

google_competencies.title: Lead Identification & Prospecting
google_competencies.definition: Sourcing high-value advertisers using digital signals.

google_competencies.title: Market Analysis & Trend Forecasting
google_competencies.definition: Identifying growth industries and regional shift signals.

google_competencies.title: Technical Literacy & Data Quality
google_competencies.definition: Leveraging cloud, data fundamentals, and ad infrastructure.

google_competencies.title: Consultative & Commercial Mindset
google_competencies.definition: Translating business goals into advertising solutions (Search, Display, Shopping, YouTube, App).

google_competencies.title: Cultural & Linguistic Agility
google_competencies.definition: Native fluency in Dutch/Spanish, navigating NL, ES, and PT markets.

interview_questions.label: Lead sourcing
interview_questions.theme: Where to find leads and how to qualify them.

interview_questions.label: Advertiser types
interview_questions.theme: Which business types and verticals are high-value advertisers.

interview_questions.label: Google interest factors
interview_questions.theme: Signals that indicate readiness for Google Ads products.

interview_questions.label: Identifying trends
interview_questions.theme: How to spot growth trends and prioritize industries.

interview_questions.label: Market trends
interview_questions.theme: Cross-market vertical insights (NL/ES/PT) and how they shift.

interview_questions.label: Data vs content
interview_questions.theme: Data quality, tracking fundamentals, and the difference between content and measurable signals.

interview_questions.label: Vertical strategy
interview_questions.theme: Which verticals scale with Google Ads and how to frame value (Search/Display/Shopping).

periods.title: Customer Support & Ads Specialist (Lisbon)
periods.focus: Commercial lead qualification and Meta cross-platform insights.
periods.copilot_directive: Highlight how the Meta Ad Library can uncover competitors who lack a Google Ads presence, creating an untapped pipeline for prospecting.

projects.name: Meta Ad Library → Google Ads Prospecting Pipeline
projects.summary: A repeatable workflow to source advertisers via Meta signals (creative velocity, offer positioning) and prioritize those likely to benefit from Google Search/Shopping capture.

projects.name: PowerStarter (Portfolio Hub)
projects.summary: React-based multi-page portfolio surface used as the customer-facing hub for showcasing systems, patterns, and prospecting narratives.

projects.name: Powerframe (Dashboard & CRM Engine)
projects.summary: Operational control center concept for managing client relations, tracking databases, and prospect qualification state.

periods.title: Cloud Data & IT Certification
periods.focus: Technical aptitude, data structures, and automation logic with tracking infrastructure context.
periods.copilot_directive: Connect Windows/Cloud Data Fundamentals to modern tracking infrastructure (Google Tag, server-side, first-party data readiness).

projects.name: Google Tag + GA4 Technical Readiness Audits
projects.summary: Website audit workflow to detect tracking presence and performance signals (tagging, speed, mobile readiness) before pitching Google Ads solutions.

projects.name: Firebase Backend Backbone (Auth + Firestore + Storage)
projects.summary: Backend reference architecture used across PowerApps and startup concepts for authentication, real-time data, and secure storage.

periods.title: Customer Support (Barcelona) & Architecture Foundations
periods.focus: Structural precision, visual networks, and cross-cultural communication; parallel between architecture and digital funnels.
periods.copilot_directive: Draw a parallel between structural engineering (foundations, hierarchy) and building digital funnels, UI/UX optimization, and visual targeting via Google Display.

projects.name: Mucho3D (ES Market) — 3D Consultation & Visualization
projects.summary: Spanish market identity for B2B 3D consultation, real estate visualization, and digital construction-oriented visual storytelling.

workflows: Visual hierarchy and landing page quality heuristics

projects.name: Flink3D (NL Market) — 3D Consultation & Visualization
projects.summary: Dutch market identity for B2B 3D consultation and visualization, emphasizing localized communication and market fluency.

parent_brand.name: WOMmedia
parent_brand.summary: Parent business umbrella engineered to deliver development, scalable solutions, and specialized consultancy for high-value verticals.

google_web_tools_and_scraping_logic.name: Google Web Tools, Extensions & Scraping Logic
google_web_tools_and_scraping_logic.summary: Auditing workflows that check websites for Google Tag and GA4 presence, plus performance and stack signals, to qualify leads before pitching Google Ads solutions.
